basic_details.job_title: NFDC General Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Film Development Corporation Ltd. (NFDC), a Government of India Enterprise at NFDC-FD Complex, Mumbai, has invited applications for one unreserved General Manager (North) post at Delhi on the pay scale (IDA) of Rs. 100000-260000 (Level E-7). The post is on direct recruitment, immediate absorption or deputation basis, under Advertisement No. 01/Regular/2026. The age limit is up to 50 years on the date of closing of application. qualification.details: The essential educational qualifications are mandatory, and only full time/regular courses will be considered. All essential qualifications must be from a UGC recognized Indian University/UGC recognized Indian Deemed University or an AICTE approved course from Autonomous Indian Institutions/concerned statutory council (wherever applicable). selection_process: The notice refers to an interview date and to a next stage of selection. NFDC will verify eligibility with reference to the original documents on the date of interview. A candidate not found eligible during document verification will not be considered for the next stage and the candidature will be rejected. subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria. The notice does not describe the stages in further detail.
how_to_apply: Apply online only through www.nfdcindia.com, Careers section.
Keep a valid e-mail ID and Mobile Number handy while applying online.

Send the system-generated application printout with self-attested documents, by hand or post, to General Manager (P&A), NFDC, NFDC-FD Complex, 24, Dr.G.D. Marg, Peddar Road, Cumbala Hill, Mumbai-400 026.
Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of General Manager (North)".
Government, PSU and Autonomous Body employees must apply through proper channel.

For deputation, Cadre Controlling Authorities may forward applications of eligible and willing officers, with relevant documents, to MD, NFDC, NFDC-FD Complex, 24, Dr Gopalrao Deshmukh Marg, Mumbai 400 026, within 30 days of the advertisement being posted on the NFDC website.
The notice allows applications within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News. The publication date is not printed in the notice.
System-generated application printout with self-attested documents.
For Govt./PSU/Autonomous Body employees: NOC, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, penalty statement (last 10 years) and APARs (last 5 years).
Copy of the equivalence certificate, for candidates claiming equivalence in qualification.
Original documents, which NFDC will use to verify eligibility on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: About NFDC
content_sections.text: National Film Development Corporation Ltd. is a Government of India Enterprise. Its office is on the 5th Floor, NMIC Building, NFDC-FD Complex, 24, Dr. Gopalrao Deshmukh Marg, Mumbai 400 026, and its CIN is U92100MH1975GOI022994. The notice is for NFDC, Mumbai, and the General Manager (North) post is shown at Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification (essential), any one of: Ph-D 2 years full time Post Graduation degree 2 years full time Post Graduate Diploma The degree or diploma is in Mass Communication/Film Studies/Mass Media/Journalism/Film Archiving. Experience (essential): 15 Years' experience with PSU/Any Govt. Organization/Private sector (with minimum 10 years of relevant in a Sr. Managerial position) Minimum 7 years' experience in business development/Intl. relations/media planning/Skill development related to films Desirable: Diploma/Certificates in Film Studies/Media Studies/Film Archiving/Curating Programmer The maximum age is up to 50 years on the date of closing of application. The notice prints no minimum age. The essential educational qualifications are mandatory, and only full time/regular courses will be considered. All essential qualifications must be from a UGC recognized Indian University/UGC recognized Indian Deemed University or an AICTE approved course from Autonomous Indian Institutions/concerned statutory council (wherever applicable). No claim of possession of a qualification equivalent to the prescribed one will be entertained, except for ex-servicemen. Candidates claiming equivalence must produce a copy of the equivalence certificate. For Degree/Diploma in Management with a mention of dual specialization, one of the specializations must be function specific for which the post has been advertised. Candidates should read the official notification for the full eligibility criteria of the post.

rows.category: Ex-servicemen and commissioned officers including Emergency Commissioned Officers of Short Service Commissioned Officers: upper age limit relaxed by the length of military service increased by three years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post carries the pay scale (IDA) of Rs. 100000-260000, shown as 100000 – 260000 (E7) in the notice, at Level E-7. The notice does not name any allowance. The vacancy is open on Direct recruitment/Immediate Absorption/Deputation basis. Deputation (GM North): officers of Central/State Government, UT Administration, PSUs, Universities, Recognized Research Institutions, Semi-Government, Autonomous or Statutory Bodies may apply. Initial deputation is for 3 years, extendable by another 2 years on a yearly basis based on performance. Eligibility criteria, Current Pay/CTC, Other Terms and Conditions and General Instructions are provided on www.nfdcindia.com , Career section.

content_sections.heading: NFDC GENERAL MANAGER (NORTH) Job Description
content_sections.text: Head of the Regional office, responsible for its operational and financial efficiency: business development, making the cost center profitable, business acquisition, liaising and coordination with all stakeholders, high-quality business strategies and plans, policy and strategy alignment with organizational goals, managing various verticals of the regional office, internal control, budgets, optimum utilization of resources and efficient manpower management. Identifying and deciding alternatives to make Promotion, Programming and Production units profitable. Identifying and implementing growth plans in the light of technological and environmental changes. Providing policy guidelines for the departments and sections below him/her. Liaisoning with other Regional Offices, Ministries of Central & State Governments, Departments and external agencies to fulfill the business targets. Resolving and controlling budgets and resources to achieve targets. Developing continuously the motivation level and competence level of the people working in the Head office, Mumbai. Directing and controlling the Regional functions, departments and sections to achieve the plans and targets. To identify and implement strategic options and viable long term, medium term and short term plans to make the business competitive and profitable, and to manage the various business activities of the given territory in order to generate profit for NFDC. To provide leadership to the group of people working with him to draw maximum contribution from them and to steer to achieve the set revenue and growth targets.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NFDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of General Manager (North) at Delhi, and it is Unreserved.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NFDC General Manager (North)?
faq.answer: Candidates may apply within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News. The notice does not print the publication date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NFDC General Manager (North)?
faq.answer: The qualification is Ph-D, or a 2 years full time Post Graduation degree, or a 2 years full time Post Graduate Diploma in Mass Communication/Film Studies/Mass Media/Journalism/Film Archiving.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required for the NFDC General Manager post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for 15 Years' experience with PSU/Any Govt. Organization/Private sector, with minimum 10 years of relevant experience in a Sr. Managerial position. It also asks for minimum 7 years' experience in business development/Intl. relations/media planning/Skill development related to films.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NFDC General Manager (North)?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years on the date of closing of application. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, 10 years for PwBD and 3 years for ex-servicemen and commissioned officers, as the notice explains.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of NFDC General Manager (North)?
faq.answer: The post carries the pay scale (IDA) of Rs. 100000-260000 at Level E-7.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for NFDC General Manager (North)?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the Careers section of www.nfdcindia.com. Then send the system-generated application printout with self-attested documents, by hand or post, to General Manager (P&A), NFDC, NFDC-FD Complex, 24, Dr.G.D. Marg, Peddar Road, Cumbala Hill, Mumbai-400 026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NFDC General Manager (North) post open on deputation?
faq.answer: Yes, the post is on Direct recruitment/Immediate Absorption/Deputation basis. Officers of Central/State Government, UT Administration, PSUs, Universities, Recognized Research Institutions, Semi-Government, Autonomous or Statutory Bodies may apply. Initial deputation is for 3 years, extendable by another 2 years on a yearly basis based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. What must government and PSU employees attach to the application?
faq.answer: They must apply through proper channel with NOC, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, penalty statement (last 10 years) and APARs (last 5 years).
